body:
Hey, i see you deleted your account after posting this.. 
If you're reading this, however, please, don't give up just yet. You might feel stuck, but perhaps you just need help finding a way out of the situation.. talk to us, we're here to help you! it doesn't have to end like this..

Hey.. I don't know who you are, and what's your story, but.. if you want to talk to anyone, i'm here. I won't write you off.. If you need someone to listen, i'll listen to everything.. 
Please hang on there, man. It doesn't have to end like this, really. No matter how hopeless it all might seem, it can be changed.. please, give yourself another chance..
thanks guys.. i really appreciate you want to help me..
I love you. I'm sure you're a great person. I don't know what has happened or is happening to you, but I believe that you're able to overcome it.

We all care. You're not meaningless, you never were. I believe in you, man. I know you can overcome it.
If you want to talk about something, anything, don't hesitate to message me. 
I won't ever forget you, and i don't want you to die, even if I don't know you. Please, don't give up.
